title: PhD in Cognitive Digital Twins & AI
field: Artificial intelligence, knowledge graphs and stream processing
about: PhD scholarship in the Stream Intelligence Lab (Prof. Pieter Bonte) at KU Leuven campus Kulak in Kortrijk, researching a Cognitive Digital Twin for monitoring critical infrastructure at sea. One-year contract, extendable, targeting completion within four years.
requirements: Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or similar

upskill.name: Knowledge Representation & Reasoning I
why: "Knowledge graphs" (skill) → "Knowledge graphs: Freebase, Wikidata, Google Knowledge Graph - structured world knowledge"
"Logic" (skill) → "Ontologies and semantic web: OWL, RDF, SPARQL for machine-readable knowledge"
